Answers:
- (d) Matching:
i) Fire-Hymn -> c) Keki N. Daruwalla

iii) Song of Myself -> e) Walt Whitman

- (e) Translations:
i) गुरु हमें ज्ञान देते हैं। -> Teachers impart knowledge to us.
